verdicts.human_summary: Concern about cascading synchronous filesystem API calls and whether they can be avoided for better efficiency
verdicts.reasoning: AI Comment 1 raises the exact same concern: it flags that existsSync calls per candidate extension create individual stat syscalls instead of using the established getDirectoryFiles + Set.has() caching pattern (a single bulk directory read). Both the human and AI comment identify the same performance issue of cascading sync fs calls at the same location and suggest the same solution — using the directory caching approach.
